source_text: The American College of Nurse-Midwives (ACNM) issued a 2024 position statement emphasizing that newborn male circumcision is not routinely recommended, advocating instead for evidence-based, unbiased shared decision-making to enable parents to elect or decline the procedure based on comprehensive information.
